property.label: Heading
property.description: NOTE: Only use this design attribute if heading is static across all events. Otherwise if left blank the heading will be set dynamically through the Campaign Service component response.
property.name: heading

property.label: Show Loading State?
property.description: If this is checked it will show loading cards (and hide the heading) while card data is being fetched. Note, if no results come back the entire component will then be hidden.
property.name: showLoading

property.label: Marketplace Event Id
property.description: Use Campaign (Marketplace Event) Detail Page Record Id: {!recordId}
property.name: campaign
